body:
Thanks @Haroenv that's helpful. I'd been checking out the `useHits` documentation and had noticed the warning to not use `transformItems` to remove items as it would affect pagination. Would injecting the banner into `items` affect pagination too? 

We don't use infinite scroll and we have a grid layout that we want to keep looking nice and neat. I was wondering if we would need to modify `hitsPerPage` to ask for 19 items instead of 20 if we are showing 1 banner on the current page (for example), then reset it back to 20 when the user moves to a page without a banner? Can you think of anything else pagination-related that we'd need to handle? I was wondering if we'd have to use `offset`?
